noticeNativeId: prod1amer/ALDI Recalls Priano Protein Carbonara Tortelloni and Priano Protein Herb Cheese Tortelloni Because Of Possible Health Riskpdf
reviewNotes: ALDI launch batch, reviewed 2026-11-16 against the notice ALDI's index dated November 16, 2026 (the notice prints no date of its own). No FDA or FSIS counterpart in Lotly's agency corpus or FDA's Enforcement Report that day; when one is published the monitor re-decides the notice as a link candidate and the read path hides it. One notice, two items under one lot and date: the product name names both, as the notice does. Botulism risk comes from possible temperature abuse, not a confirmed contamination: whyRecalled says so in the notice's own words.

fields.productName: Priano Protein Carbonara Tortelloni and Priano Protein Herb & Cheese Tortelloni
fields.whatHappened: ALDI is recalling Priano Protein Carbonara Tortelloni and Priano Protein Herb & Cheese Tortelloni sold at select stores. The products may not have been stored, distributed or sold at appropriate temperatures. No illnesses have been reported.
fields.whyRecalled: The products may not have been stored at appropriate temperatures, which may allow growth of pathogens including Clostridium botulinum.
instructions: Do not prepare or eat the product, even if it does not look or smell spoiled.
Throw it away or return it to your local ALDI store for a full refund.
fields.contact: Call ALDI at 844-484-0332, Monday through Friday, from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. EST.
